description: Seed corpus of APPROVED procedures for grounding/retrieval evaluation. Only approved procedures are ever retrievable (api-contracts §10.2).

procedures.title: Hearth sector over-temperature verification
procedures.observation: A hearth sector reads high while cooling flow appears nominal.
procedures.recommended_check: Compare with neighboring shell thermocouples and review cooling-water inlet/outlet temperature and recent flow history.
procedures.rationale: Corroborating independent signals distinguishes a real thermal event from a single faulty sensor.
procedures.safety_boundary: Do not bypass alarms or change furnace/cooling setpoints from this guidance; escalate to engineering.

procedures.title: Thermocouple health validation
procedures.observation: Suspected drift on a shell thermocouple.
procedures.recommended_check: Validate sensor health and recent calibration; request ultrasound measurement when signals agree.
procedures.rationale: Calibration and cross-checks prevent acting on instrument faults.
procedures.safety_boundary: Only engineering may authorize control changes.
